assessment.comparison: Establishes the cross-family architecture in B19 between USEtox/ILCD/EF (3 midpoints in CTUh and freshwater CTUe, excluding marine/terrestrial midpoints and most endpoints) and ReCiPe 2016 USES-LCA 2.0 (5 1,4-DCB-referenced midpoints, porewater-extrapolated industrial-soil terrestrial ecotoxicity excluding agricultural soil to avoid double counting with land use, and perspective-invariant endpoint factors). Demonstrates controlled rank reversals across EF 3.0 -> 3.1 0.2/HC20 + EU REACH/EFSA data (Cu vs Hg reversing >4 orders of magnitude from 45:1 to 1:714; Al/Cu drops vs Cd/Ag/Hg top-three rise; vs 20/17 = 1.176 fallback for Sb(III)) and across ReCiPe I/H/E five coupled switches + EF 3.1 (urban-air 100 kg 1,4-DCB vs 1 kg Ni reversing I > H/E < EF 3.1; seawater 1 kg each reversing I vs H/E/EF 3.1), plus speciation/2019-sales-pesticide/unspecified-water proxy rules and normative zeros (-44% HT_nc NF vs +4,438% avoided-emission credit jump).
